phenotypicFeatures.description: progressive weakness of his hands and a reduction of grip strength
muscle atrophy and muscle fibrillation were noticed in his hands
unable to hold things or to write
weakness in his lower extremities
difficulty in climbing the stairs and standing up from a squatting position
unable to lift his foot upward
trips over easily
triceps and biceps 3/3, forearm flexors 2/2, intrinsic hand muscles 1/1, iliopsoas muscles 4/4, quadriceps muscles 3/3, tibialis anterior and gastrocnemius muscles 2/2
Deep tendon reflexes were absent
Atrophy was seen in most of the muscles, especially the interosseous muscles of the hands, bilateral gastrocnemius and anterior tibial muscles
Muscle fibrillation was observed in the biceps and quadriceps muscles
serum level of creatine kinase was 668 U/L
severe reduction in compound muscle action potential (CMAP) amplitudes and motor conduction velocities
Right ulnar nerve F-waves were absent
Chronic denervation/reinnervation... was observed in three regions on the electromyogram (EMG)
spontaneous activity (positive sharp waves) was recorded from these muscles
marked involvement of the gastrocnemius muscle at the calf level
strongly increased signal intensity in turbo inversion recovery magnitude (TIRM) sequences, indicating muscular edema
mild increase in the signal intensity of soleus and tibialis anterior muscles was observed in the T2 sequence, indicating fat replacement

type.label: Increased variability in muscle fiber diameter

phenotypicFeatures.description: marked variation in fiber size was observed, with many angular atrophic fibers
abnormal material deposits after staining with hematoxylin–eosin

type.label: Type 1 and type 2 muscle fiber minicore regions

phenotypicFeatures.description: oxidative activity was reduced in fibrous areas occupied by the inclusions, showing core-like lesions
inordinate myofibrillar structure and dissolved myofilaments

type.label: Intracellular accumulation of autofluorescent lipopigment storage material

phenotypicFeatures.description: Subsarcolemmal accumulations of lipofuscin were also present
